name: Mars Needs Mail
author: Sophiacorn
description:
Help the Martians of Mars to collect mail from Earth. 
But watch out, the posties are onto you! 
Don't get caught by them or their drones. 
Also watch out for dogs, some might need your help, others work for the post office, so watch out! This is my first self initiated project I have made beside following tutorials online. I really hope you enjoy it.
All artwork and animation's are made in Aseprite.
